messages:
maria_pm: quick sync — we need to lock the packaging + upgrade strategy for Q3 private deploys. customer-managed networking edge cases keep changing, and we need a clear rollout plan by EOD fri

noah_sales: which customers are on the critical path? AcmeHealth and LogiBank both asked for a non-disruptive upgrade window last week. they want pinned versions + rollback plan.

sasha_infra: noted. two main constraints: (1) customers with strict NAT/firewall policies can't receive push updates easily, (2) air-gapped installs need a tarball + offline agent approach. both affect upgrade UX and automation.

devon_eng: proposal: support two upgrade modes - "push coordinator" for VPC + "pull bundle" for airgap. push = our control plane triggers in-place rollout; pull = customer runs a one-time bootstrap that pulls a signed bundle and runs offline upgrade.

lia_se: +1. also need a simple preflight check for network/certs and a one-line rollback if things fail. customers keep asking for an audit trail of each step.

maria_pm: agree. can we sketch minimal launch criteria? my draft: 1) safe rollback path documented and automatic, 2) preflight checks catch mismatches, 3) telemetry emitted for each upgrade step, 4) 2 pilot customers completed (one VPC, one airgap).

devon_eng: timeline estimate: eng work ~2w (controller + bundle signing), qa ~1w (upgrade simulation + rollback tests), docs + SE runbook ~1w. parallelize where possible.

noah_sales: pilots: AcmeHealth can be VPC pilot, LogiBank wants airgap test. both ok to run in May if we can finish implementation by mid-April.

sasha_infra: operational concerns: for push coordinator we need to handle partial failures (node churn mid-upgrade). plan: per-node state machine + idempotent steps + final reconciliation pass. failure mode doc should include commands:

```
# inspect node upgrade state
redwoodctl node-status --node <node-id> --deploy <deploy-id>
# force rollback
redwoodctl upgrade rollback --deploy <deploy-id> --to-version 1.3.2
```

lia_se: for airgap bundles, signing + verification is non-negotiable. we should generate a signed manifest and let customers verify with our public key. add a sample preflight: 

```
redwoodctl preflight --env vpc --agent-version 1.4.0 --k8s-version 1.24
```

ops-bot: calendar: reminded participants about the packaging sync on 1935010800 (calendar invite created).

devon_eng: questions: do we gate rollout on model-serving runtime compatibility? shipping a control-plane-only change that impacts agent handshake requires careful runtime gating. suggestion: default fallback to legacy handshake protocol for one release window.

maria_pm: ok to include handshake fallback as a guarded opt-in flag. add to launch checklist: feature-flag + telemetry showing <=0.5% handshake errors in canary.

lia_se: need template customer comms: planned window, rollback instructions, preflight checklist, and expected downtimes (should be zero for in-place, small for airgap). i'll draft.

noah_sales: also include SLA notes: if customers choose immediate push updates, we need a clear clause about maintenance windows and support response times.

sasha_infra: deployment automation note: if customers use managed NAT traversal, we can shorten upgrade time by ~30%. track that as a capability in account metadata so SEs can set expectations.

maria_pm: prioritization: must-have = preflight + rollback + telemetry + two pilots. nice-to-have = automated canary cohorts by account size, UI progress visualization, built-in bundle mirror hosting.

devon_eng: blockers: need a signing key flow approved by security, and an HSM/KMS story for the private deploy offering. can we escalate?

maria_pm: i'll ping security. @sasha_infra can you help with the KMS requirements doc?

sasha_infra: yes, i'll put a draft in go/private-upgrades-kms and tag security.

lia_se: for pilot runbooks, I'll include a checklist: backup config, confirm backup restore path, preflight output, dry-run command, rollback command, post-upgrade validation tests (smoke LLM inference, KV cache warmup).

devon_eng: final QA plan: run an automated matrix across (k8s versions, agent versions, sequence lengths) and simulate network partitions. failure scenarios must have automated reconciliation.

maria_pm: decision points for EOD fri: (A) accept two-mode upgrade (push + pull) and launch pilots, (B) defer airgap until post-pilot. please flag your votes.

noah_sales: vote A. customers pushing for both.

sasha_infra: vote A if security approves signing workflow by Tue.

devon_eng: vote A. we'll scope minimal airgap bundle first iteration.

lia_se: vote A. i'll prepare pilot onboarding docs. :thumbsup:

maria_pm: thanks everyone — i'll update the roadmap ticket and create the pilot epics. leaving notes for follow-ups: security KMS runway, eng task breakdown, SE pilot scheduling. meeting follow-up will land as PRD update.

ops-bot: thread archived after 48h of inactivity.
